name: Dr. Souvik Mahapatra
about: Dr. Souvik Mahapatra is a dedicated and compassionate healthcare professional. With clinical experience as a General Physician and a background in comprehensive medical care, he is committed to providing holistic healthcare solutions and comprehensive patient care.

name: Dr. Ritwika Saha
expertise: Emergency Medicine, ICU Management & Clinical Pharmacology
about: Dr. Ritwika Saha is a skilled medical practitioner with extensive experience across Emergency, Respiratory ICU, and HDU setups. She specializes in preliminary diagnostic evaluations, patient stabilization, clinical pharmacology, and comprehensive vital monitoring.
certifications: West Bengal Medical Council (WBMC) Reg. No. 83963

name: Ayushi Gangwar
about: Ayushi has expertise in clinical nutrition, personalized diet planning, and therapeutic nutrition counseling. She provides practical, evidence-based dietary guidance to help patients improve their health, drawing from her experience at Chandan Hospital.

name: Shikha Sharma
about: Shikha Sharma is a clinical nutritionist with experience in hospital settings. She specializes in creating balanced, personalized diet plans tailored to both vegetarian and non-vegetarian lifestyles to support overall health and clinical recovery.

name: Dr. Ujjwal Kumar
about: Dr. Ujjwal Kumar is a dedicated and compassionate healthcare professional. With clinical experience as a Duty Medical Officer and a background in homeopathic medicine, he is committed to providing holistic healthcare solutions and comprehensive patient care.

name: Ms. Laxmi Singh
about: Ms. Laxmi Singh is a certified Yoga Instructor dedicated to promoting physical, mental, and emotional well-being through yoga. She holds a Post Graduation Diploma in Yoga Education and is certified by the Yoga Certification Board in Yoga Teaching and Evaluation. Her approach combines traditional yoga practices with modern wellness techniques to help individuals achieve a healthier and balanced lifestyle.
certifications: Yoga Certification Board - Yoga Teaching and Evaluation

name: Priyanka Bhagat
qualification: Principles of Nutrition, Gut Health, Holistic Health, Integrative Dietetics
expertise: Weight Management, Nutrition Counseling & Holistic Wellness
about: Priyanka Bhagat is a Nutritionist and Weight Loss Expert with 6 years of experience in the health and wellness industry. She specializes in nutrition counseling, lifestyle modification, weight management, and holistic wellness. With certifications in Principles of Nutrition, Gut Health, Holistic Health, and Integrative Dietetics, she helps clients achieve sustainable health goals through personalized nutrition strategies and evidence-based guidance. She has successfully guided more than 100 clients toward healthier lifestyles through consistent coaching, education, and wellness consultations.

name: Mr. Aswin
qualification: Anytime Fitness Gym Trainer and Coach
expertise: Certified Fitness Trainer and Gym Coach with dedicated experience.
about: Mr. Aswin is a dedicated and compassionate fitness professional. With clinical experience as a Fitness Trainer and Gym Coach, he is committed to providing holistic fitness solutions and comprehensive patient care.
